functions.name: COUNT

parameters.description: Column to count or * for all rows

functions.description: Counts the number of rows or non-null values
examples: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users -- Count all rows
SELECT COUNT(email) FROM users -- Count non-null emails
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM users -- Count unique cities

functions.name: COUNTIF
functions.description: Counts rows where condition is true
examples: SELECT COUNTIF(age > 18) FROM users -- Count adults

functions.name: COUNT_IF
functions.description: Counts rows where condition is true

functions.name: SUM
functions.description: Calculates the sum of numeric values

functions.name: AVG
functions.description: Calculates the average of numeric values

functions.name: MIN
functions.description: Returns the minimum value

functions.name: MAX
functions.description: Returns the maximum value

functions.name: STRING_AGG
functions.description: Concatenates strings from a group into a single string
examples: SELECT STRING_AGG(name, ', ') FROM users GROUP BY department
SELECT STRING_AGG(tag, '|' ORDER BY tag) FROM product_tags

functions.name: ARRAY_AGG
functions.description: Aggregates values into an array
examples: SELECT ARRAY_AGG(product_id) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id

functions.name: COLLECT_LIST
functions.description: Collects values into a list/array
examples: SELECT COLLECT_LIST(item_name) FROM cart GROUP BY user_id

functions.name: ARG_MAX
functions.returnType: Same as first argument, nullable if empty
functions.description: Returns the value of the first column at the row with max value of second column
examples: SELECT ARG_MAX(product_name, price) FROM products -- Product with highest price
SELECT ARG_MAX(employee_name, salary) FROM employees GROUP BY department

functions.name: ARG_MIN
functions.returnType: Same as first argument, nullable if empty
functions.description: Returns the value of the first column at the row with min value of second column
examples: SELECT ARG_MIN(product_name, price) FROM products -- Cheapest product
SELECT ARG_MIN(student_name, score) FROM exam_results GROUP BY class

functions.name: MAX_BY
functions.returnType: Same as first argument, nullable if empty

parameters.description: Value column, comparison column, number of values

functions.description: Returns top N values based on comparison column
examples: SELECT MAX_BY(product_name, revenue, 5) FROM sales -- Top 5 products by revenue

functions.name: MIN_BY
functions.returnType: Same as first argument, nullable if empty

parameters.description: Value column, comparison column, number of values

functions.description: Returns bottom N values based on comparison column
examples: SELECT MIN_BY(product_name, price, 5) FROM products -- 5 cheapest products

functions.name: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT

parameters.description: Column to count, optional error rate

functions.description: Approximates the number of distinct values using HyperLogLog

functions.name: APPROX_PERCENTILE
functions.description: Approximates the percentile of numeric values

functions.name: APPROX_QUANTILES
functions.description: Approximates quantile boundaries for numeric values

functions.name: CORR
functions.description: Calculates the correlation coefficient between two numeric columns

functions.name: ARBITRARY

parameters.description: Column to select arbitrary value from

functions.description: Returns an arbitrary non-null value from the group
examples: SELECT ARBITRARY(color) FROM products GROUP BY category
SELECT ARBITRARY(manager_id) FROM employees GROUP BY department

functions.name: ANY_VALUE

parameters.description: Column to select any value from

functions.description: Returns any value from the group (including nulls)
examples: SELECT ANY_VALUE(email) FROM users GROUP BY domain
SELECT ANY_VALUE(timestamp) FROM logs GROUP BY session_id
